name: LiquidPaymentStop
description: Stop a liquid payment; the vested part goes to the recipient, the rest back.

params.name: sender_privkey
params.help: the signing key: 32-byte Ed25519 seed as 64 hex; '-' or omitted = ZBC_KEY

params.name: transaction_id
params.help: the liquid payment's transaction id (first 8 bytes of its hash, int64 LE; often negative)
